proposals.before: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Hongwu, Ming Yu of Shu-Xia presented a surrender memorial at the capital; the founding emperor ordered the Secretariat to convene deliberation on the rite of receiving surrender.
proposals.after: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Hongwu, Ming Sheng of Shu-Xia presented a surrender memorial at the capital; the founding emperor ordered the Secretariat to convene deliberation on the rite of receiving surrender.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明升 is Ming Sheng; "Ming Yu" mistranslates 升.
